tldr: Chiron transiting the 10th house: a long healing chapter around career, reputation, authority, public standing, and legacy.
body: Chiron moving through the 10th house can reopen old material around career, reputation, authority, public standing, and legacy. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is public, in career and standing; you may feel illegitimate or exposed in your role.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through career, reputation, authority, public standing, and legacy. You mentor others toward earned authority, having doubted your own.
shadow: Overbuilding status to cover the wound, or sabotaging your own visibility.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 10th house deliberately. Work with career, reputation, authority, public standing, and legacy as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
